headline: Last session: Indian markets extended their winning streak to four weeks, with Sensex and Nifty hitting 9-month highs.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Indian stock market extended its winning streak to 4 weeks with Sensex and Nifty gaining around 3%.
Record foreign institutional investor (FII) buying supported market sentiment near 9-month highs.
Recovery in banking and IT stocks helped indices bounce back from early session dips.
Global AI selloff and Fed rate hike signals caused temporary pressure early in the week.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty 50 surged to 9-month high levels during the weekly rally.
Nifty Smallcap 100 underperformed the broader benchmark indices during the week.
FDA suspended 38 licences, impacting eateries at Air India Building and units of Zepto and Blinkit.
Gold prices fell to their lowest levels of 2026 amid global market shifts.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Nifty and Sensex extended their weekly winning streak to four weeks, reaching 9-month highs on record FII buying. Despite early pressure from global AI selloffs and rate hike fears, banking and IT stocks supported a strong market recovery. The market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.
